rows.title: The live animals list is reframed in place, scoped to the trader's organisation, and plants' list takes the same frame
rows.detail: The live animals notification list stays at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend and is reframed there to the category list the design sets out: a 'Dashboard' browser title and caption, the category as the heading, a primary 'Create new' button straight under the heading, the cards under 'Notifications' and each card named for assistive technology. The list shows only the signed-in trader's organisation's notifications, because the animals backend's list serves every trader's notifications to every caller today. Plants' own list takes the same frame in the same increment, keeping its own first question. Every new string gets a Welsh machine draft, and the k6 journey keeps working against the reframed list.
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in trader opening the live animals list at the live-animals set root sees the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Live animals'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-100; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-032, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-038; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-003, repo-frontend-p4-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086)

Signed in for one organisation, a trader sees only that organisation's notifications on the live animals list: a notification started under another organisation is not listed, and searching its reference lists nothing. The animals backend's list answers a request that does not say which organisation it acts for with a refusal rather than a list. Plants' list's h1 is followed directly by a primary 'Create new' button, and pressing it starts a high-risk plants notification and lands on its commodity type page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-022; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-005, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-006, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-007, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-045, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-075; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-020, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-087, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

The k6 journey run against the stack opens the live animals list at the live-animals set root for the crumb it posts back, creates a notification, searches the list for it by reference, finds the submitted notification's reference there, and its read of the animals backend's notification list says which organisation it acts for; every check passes. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-005, repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-089; conflict c-225)

rows.gate: Look at the reframed frame on both lists (title, caption, heading, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names) and the organisation-scoped list before the card, tab, search, filter, paging and germinal list rows copy them.
openQuestions: What plants' list heading says, when the frame names the category and the design has no plants list (c-303). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Plants', with a Welsh machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off.

How 'Create new' carries the live animals category. Default: the button keeps today's form post, which creates a live animals draft in the live-animals set and lands on its first page, so the set the button belongs to carries the category; the category stored on the record comes with the category-on-create row, and the animals frontend names the address (c-251).
rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-129: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos, its dependencies and its gate. Pass 1 slices: the frame (title, caption, h1, 'Create new', 'Notifications', card names), the organisation scoping, the Welsh drafts and the k6 check. Pass 2 keeps them in one row: one page, one review, and every later list row builds on this frame. Covers req-2029 (still a question under c-303) with its default, because plants' heading is built in this same frame change. Already met and kept, so no criterion: the list stays at the set root (req-1032), the search keeps its text (req-1047), the card's status-driven actions (req-1084, req-2033), no serious axe violation and no sideways scroll (req-1091), deleted notifications never listed (req-1094), a new notification listed straight away (req-1095), the k6 background count (req-1853). req-1035 (a 'Back' link to the overall home) is out of scope (c-298), and the 'Use template' button stays out while templates are parked (req-1038, out of scope). Welsh (req-1090) sits here because this row first changes the list copy; later list rows add Welsh drafts for their own strings. The k6 suite joins this row because it reads the crumb from the control this row renames (c-225, c-315); the search parameter's own rename is proven in the search row, which also keeps perftests in its repos. Re-distil: claim references renumbered to the current extract (repo-frontend p4, repo-plantsfrontend p1), and the Welsh criterion now also states that no label is left blank in either language (req-1090).

rows.title: Notification cards show the design's facts, on the live animals list and on plants' list
rows.detail: The card leads with what is coming, when, to whom and its status. A live animals card shows its facts in two rows, with the quantity as 'Number of animals' from the animals backend's record and the commodity as the trader chose it. The arrival date is written with the full month name, a fact the record does not hold yet reads 'Not applicable', and the arrival date is the only date the card shows. Plants' card takes the same layout with plants' own facts, and every action a plants card offers sits in one list beside its title, as the live animals card already does.
acceptanceCriteria: A live animals card shows its facts in two rows: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor'. openQuestions: What the card labels the arrival date, when the design's card says 'Arrival date' and the 17 November ruling words the arrival date 'Arrival date at port of entry' wherever it appears but names no page or component (c-421). Default, which the builder follows and says so: 'Arrival date' on the card, the design's own words for this component, with a Welsh machine draft.
rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-130: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependency on the reframe row. Pass 2 combines the card layout, labels, quantity, commodity name, date format, dates dropped and 'Not applicable': one card over one list item, proven with the same seeded set of notifications. The animals backend is in repos for the number of animals and the commodity name on its list item; the full list item shape, germinal facts included, sits in the germinal cards row. The status styles (req-1079) stay their own row so this row and the tab, search and paging rows build without waiting; the 'Inspection' fact (req-1083) waits in the blocked outcomes row. Re-distil: req-2347 is added here, because plants' posting actions move into the same card this row rebuilds, so building them apart would repeat the same set-up, review and ladder; the commodity criterion now states the recorded commodity name rather than naming a species that the catalogue's rename has moved on from; the arrival-date label is now a question (c-421) carried with its default, so the label and the status label are separate criteria.

rows.title: Card status styles on both lists
rows.detail: A tag is used only for a status that asks something of the trader. On both lists a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag and a submitted notification's status is plain styled text rather than a tag. Plants' card follows the same two styles and keeps its own 'Late' tag.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list a draft's 'Notification status' is a 'Draft' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-048, repo-frontend-p4-049; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-033)

On the live animals list a submitted notification's status reads 'Submitted' as plain styled text rather than a tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-048; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-012; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-029, trace-e2e-p3-030; conflict c-418)

On plants' list a draft's status is a 'Draft' tag, a submitted notification's status reads 'Submitted' as plain styled text, and a late notification shows its 'Late' tag beside the status. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-025, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-076; conflict c-301)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of existing row inc-131, which also carries another area's requirement about what a submitted notification with items outstanding shows. The combiner keeps inc-131's id, its animals-dashboard theme, that area's requirement and its dependencies, and merges these criteria into it. Re-distil after the 16 and 19 November rulings: the 'Action required' tag, the error card and the outstanding-items message are withdrawn (c-418), so no criterion here states them, and the claims that conflict overrules are cited nowhere in this row. Outstanding actions will reach the trader through the banner-style alert the dashboard designs under test introduce, which is another row once that design is agreed. An amending notification's yellow tag sits in the tabs row (req-1060), and the 'Completed' style (req-1739) waits in the blocked outcomes row. The backend repo is no longer needed: nothing on the card now reads a status the backend must add.

rows.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
rows.detail: The design separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications, and drafts keep a home on the list. The tabs are Ministry of Justice sub navigation on the animals frontend's own list, each a link that loads the page, over the animals backend's list, which gains category and tab filters and reports the count of notifications in flight. A notification being amended stays under 'In progress'.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', as Ministry of Justice sub navigation, each a link that loads the list with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-099, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100; conflict c-299)

Opening the list with no tab chosen, or with an unknown tab, shows the 'In progress' tab chosen; following a tab link lists that tab's notifications with no search text, no chosen sort and no filter set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-036; conflict c-251)

'In progress' lists submitted notifications, 'Draft' lists drafts and 'Completed' lists completed notifications, so a draft is listed only under 'Draft' and a submitted notification only under 'In progress'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-049; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-034; conflict c-165)

A notification being amended is listed under 'In progress', its status shown as a yellow amendment tag in the service's shared status styling, with its Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete actions. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-049, repo-frontend-p4-053, repo-frontend-p4-058; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-046, trace-animals-fit-p2-047, trace-animals-fit-p2-049; conflict c-165)

Only the 'In progress' tab shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', matching the notifications it lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show a label alone, even when chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063)

The animals backend's list narrows by category, live animals or germinal products with an absent category counting as live animals, and by tab, and reports how many notifications the 'In progress' tab holds; a live animals notification whose record holds no category is listed on the live animals list under its tab. rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-135: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependency on the card row. Pass 2 combines the tab links, membership, where an amendment is listed, the count, the subheading and the list API's category and tab filters with its count: one control over one query. The tab parameter's name and its values are the animals frontend's (c-251). No completed notification can exist until the authorities' outcome feed lands (req-1082, blocked row), so 'Completed' is proven to list none of the other statuses. That following a tab also drops the additional filters is proven in the additional-filters row, which adds them. req-1099's germinal half is observed in the germinal rows, once a germinal notification exists; here it is proven by a record with no category staying on the live animals list. Plants' tabs (req-2034) wait on the plants backend in the blocked plants row. Re-distil: the 'In progress' membership criterion no longer names an action-required status, which the 16 November ruling withdrew (c-418), and the amendment tag's criterion states a yellow tag in the shared status styling rather than quoting a word, because the word now comes from the shared status kit and the kit's wording is the status strip's to settle (c-165).

rows.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
rows.detail: The design lays the list out in one column and puts search and sort in one form with one submit control. The afternoon ruling makes it one GET form whose icon-only submit button searches and sorts on the server, so the page works without JavaScript. Today's search matches only one exact, whole reference, so it becomes a real keyword search over the reference, commodity, consignee and consignor. The sort offers three orderings, is applied for real and breaks ties so paging is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list and on plants' list the search and sort sit in one column above the cards inside the 'Notifications' section, with the cards in the same column below them; on the live animals list the 'Additional filters' disclosure follows them, above the tabs. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-006, repo-frontend-p4-013, repo-frontend-p4-014; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-009, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-013; conflict c-167)

The live animals list's search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-039, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-015; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-084)

The search is submitted by a real submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and whose accessible name is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-047; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; conflict c-299)

Searching lists every notification whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains the searched text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces: part of a consignee's name finds that notification, and a lower-case part of a reference finds it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-019, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-010, repo-backend-p3-011, repo-backend-p3-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-016; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-162)

Search, sort and the additional filters are one GET form to the list's own address, submitted by the search button; it carries the current tab, unless 'In progress', and the current page when above 1, so the result stays on that tab. Changing the sort select or a filter radio submits nothing by itself, and the list's only submit control is the search button. The sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-029, repo-frontend-p4-030; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-094, repo-tests-p3-095; conflict c-161)

'Newest first' lists the most recently created notification first, 'Oldest first' the earliest created first, and 'Arrival date' the latest arrival date first; with no sort chosen the list is in arrival date order, newest first, with 'Arrival date' chosen in the select, and the chosen option stays chosen after the page reloads with no button of its own to apply it. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-051; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-006, repo-backend-p3-007; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-031, repo-frontend-p4-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-161)

Paging through a sorted list in which several notifications share the sorted date, such as drafts with no arrival date, shows every notification exactly once across the pages. The animals backend's list takes a search text and returns every notification whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains it, ignoring case and surrounding spaces, paged like any other list. rows.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
rows.detail: The design keeps the extra filters out of the way until the trader needs them. They sit inside the one GET form, built from the GOV.UK details component with GOV.UK radios and a select and a Ministry of Justice date picker at each end of the date range. The filters narrow the list for real, through the animals backend's list, and a date a filter cannot use is answered with an error rather than ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Inside the search form the live animals list has an 'Additional filters' disclosure, built from the GOV.UK details component, closed when the list first loads and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-054; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-016; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; conflict c-299)

The additional filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small GOV.UK radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days', with those same words as its heading and as a visually hidden legend; choosing one and searching lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-003; conflict c-162)

The additional filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two Ministry of Justice date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each a plain text field without JavaScript; searching lists only notifications arriving between the two dates, and the entered dates stay in the fields. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-102; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-051, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-056, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-037, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-038, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-039, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; ruling:interaction-designer-2026-11-09 ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09-p1-040)

With JavaScript, each date picker offers a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102)

Searching with a start date that cannot be read as a date shows a GOV.UK error summary and the inline error 'Enter a real start date'; an end date that cannot be read shows 'Enter a real end date'; an end date before the start date shows 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'. Each time, 'Additional filters' is open, the entered text stays in the 'Start date' and 'End date' fields, and the list is shown without the date-range filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-26 ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-002, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-003, ruling-sam-2026-10-26-p1-019; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-047; conflict c-166)

The additional filters have a 'Status' select offering exactly 'Select one', 'Submitted' and 'Completed'; choosing a status and searching lists only notifications in it, and the choice stays chosen. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-035; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-058; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-024, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-026; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

Following a tab link lists that tab's notifications with every additional filter cleared, as well as the search text and the chosen sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)

The animals backend's list narrows by status and by an arrival-date range whose from and to dates are each optional. (document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-002, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-025, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-028; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; conflict c-162)

rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-137: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependency on the search-and-sort row. Pass 2 combines the disclosure, the three filter columns, the date validation and the list API's status and arrival-date filters: one section of one form over one query. No custom JavaScript: the GOV.UK details component, radios and select, and the Ministry of Justice date picker the animals frontend already has, which the interaction designer keeps for every other date in both frontends; build each end of the range with the frontend's own date-field kit, which now always gives the house calendar. 'Completed' matches nothing until the authorities' outcome feed exists (req-1082, blocked row), and the select still offers it. The prototype's lack of date validation is overruled (c-166), and the 26 October ruling sets the same error shape for every answer that is missing or not valid. This row also proves the half of the tabs requirement the tabs row cannot: following a tab clears the filters this row adds. Re-distil: the 'Action required' option is taken out of the status criterion and carried as the row's open question with its default, because the 16 November ruling withdrew the status behind it (c-418) and whether the filter still offers the word is undecided.

rows.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and show neither a results count nor an empty-state message
rows.detail: The design pages every list 8 at a time with numbered pagination, clamps the page so a stale address never shows an empty list, and shows no count of results and no message when a list holds nothing. Because the real search and filters apply, a page link carries them. Plants' list takes the numbered pagination and drops its results line and empty messages in the same increment; its page size waits on the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-005; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-070; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-081; ruling:ian-2026-11-23 ruling-ian-2026-11-23-p1-008, ruling-ian-2026-11-23-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092)

The animals backend's list serves 8 notifications a page, numbered from 1, and reports the page, the size, the number of elements on it, the total elements and the total pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004, repo-backend-p3-005, repo-backend-p3-014, repo-backend-p3-077)

A list of more than one page shows GOV.UK pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 and a 'Next' link before the last page; a list of one page, or of no notifications, shows the cards alone with no pagination. This holds on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-071, repo-frontend-p4-072; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-031; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-082, repo-tests-p3-083; ruling:ian-2026-11-25 ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-002, ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-003; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Opening the live animals list at a page number below 1 or not a number shows page 1, and at a page past the last shows the last page; plants' list does the same. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-075, repo-frontend-p4-076; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-033)

On the live animals list every page link carries the current tab unless 'In progress', the chosen sort unless the default, the search text and every additional filter, so page 2 of a filtered list lists the same filtered set. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-035, repo-frontend-p4-074; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-092; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-064; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-039, trace-e2e-p2-040; conflict c-163)

On the live animals list and on plants' list, a search or filter that matches nothing shows the list with no cards and no message about the result. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-015, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-082; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-087; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-054, trace-animals-fit-p2-055)

rows.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
rows.detail: What needs the trader's attention sits at the top of each category list, in two glance cards whose counts agree with the pages they link to. The afternoon ruling counts these Summary cards as the front door's summary information, so they wait until its requirements firm up, and what counts as needing action waits on the outstanding-actions banner the dashboard designs under test introduce.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed page for the category, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes page for the category. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-036, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-037, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-042, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-043, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-044; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-099)

The 'Action needed' card shows a live count for the category of the notifications that need something from the trader, and it matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-019; conflict c-148, c-149)
openQuestions: Blocked: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with. Once they exist this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which pages its links open are decided then.

Blocked as well for the 'Action needed' count: the outstanding-actions banner the dashboard designs under test introduce must be agreed (Sam, 16 November), because nothing action-required is shown until then. Who: Sam and the designers taking those designs through test.
rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-139, still blocked: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependencies. Nothing in the reframed list depends on this row. The counts are computed from the same set the page each link opens lists, for the signed-in organisation; the design's fixed glance numbers are overruled (c-148). Repos are the animals backend, the animals frontend and the tests suite, because the list it sits on stays in the animals frontend; re-check when it is re-distilled. The 'Status updated' count (req-1735) waits as well, in the outcomes row, because it also needs the authorities' outcomes. Re-distil: the 'Action needed' criterion now states a live count of the notifications that need something from the trader rather than counting a tag the 16 November ruling withdrew (c-418), and the row carries that ruling's block as a second open question.

rows.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success'
rows.detail: One success banner, titled 'Success', is shown when an action sends the trader back to a list. The message itself is the action's own, and the flag the action puts on the redirect keeps triggering the banner. Plants' banner takes the same title in the same increment. The new wording goes in each list feature's own copy, because the shared action wording other pages use is not reworded in place.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification, the live animals list shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's own message. rows.title: The germinal products set's root renders its own copy of the reframed list

The germinal list is the germinal set's own copy of the reframed live animals list, at the germinal set's root in the animals frontend, rather than a hand-off to another service. It shows only germinal products notifications, and its 'Create new' starts a germinal notification in the germinal set.

rows.title: Germinal products notifications on their own list, with their own card facts
rows.detail: A trader looking at one category must not see another's notifications. The animals backend's list returns every fact a card shows, including each notification's category and its quantity, and for germinal products its packages with each line's species and product type, so the germinal cards say what is coming in the germinal way and the live animals list leaves germinal notifications out.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification is not listed on the live animals list, and searching its reference there lists nothing. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112; conflict c-159)

A notification whose record holds no category is listed on the live animals list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-112)

The animals backend's list returns, for each notification, its reference number, status, commodity name, arrival date, origin, consignee name, consignor name and category, and its number of animals or, for germinal products, its number of packages with each line's species and product type; a fact the notification does not hold comes back empty. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015, repo-backend-p3-016, repo-backend-p3-017, repo-backend-p3-078; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-039, repo-frontend-p4-045-m1, repo-frontend-p4-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105; conflict c-159)

A germinal products notification's card shows the commodity as the species, then a comma, then the product type, such as 'Cattle, Semen'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-063; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105; conflict c-297)

rows.title: Each set stores the category it creates a draft with, so a notification reaches its own list
rows.detail: Live animals and germinal products are sibling sets keeping their notifications in one animals backend, so the stored record is what tells the two apart. Each set passes its category when it creates a draft, so a germinal notification reaches the germinal products list and a live animals one the live animals list, and a record with no category counts as live animals so notifications stored before the germinal set existed stay on the live animals list without a data migration.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft the germinal products set creates is stored with the category germinal products, and is not listed on the live animals list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)

A draft the live-animals set creates is stored with the category live animals, and is listed on the live animals list. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-030)
rows.notes: This is the notification-list area's share of existing row inc-176, the germinal set's first row, which already holds req-1856 and req-1857 beside the backend category field, the cross-set guard and the set's chrome: one backend field and one create path, observable only through the germinal set's create. The combiner keeps inc-176's id, its germinal-products theme, its gate, its repos, its dependencies and its external dependencies, and merges these criteria into it rather than making a second row. That the germinal draft then appears on the germinal list is proven by the germinal list row, which depends on inc-176; here it is observed as absent from the live animals list, whose category filter the tabs row builds. Unchanged in substance by this re-distil.

rows.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed, completed, inspection, their actions and the status-updated count
rows.detail: What the authorities decide after submission is shown on the list: a delayed notification with its reason, a completed notification in its own tab, an inspection warning, and the actions a card in those statuses offers. None of these outcomes reaches the service today, so the row waits on the authorities' case system; the status-updated count also waits on the front door's dashboard requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification shows a 'Delayed' tag on an error card whose message is the reason for the delay recorded on the notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows the status 'Completed' as plain styled text rather than a tag, and is listed in the 'Completed' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-065, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-066; ruling:sam-2026-11-16 ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-11-16-p1-020)

A notification chosen for inspection shows an extra 'Inspection' fact with a 'Required' tag at the end of its card's second row. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-069)

A card whose notification is delayed, completed, or needs something from the trader with no status-driven action set of its own offers 'Copy as new' then 'View', and 'View' opens the notification's review page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-047, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-048, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-049; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-054; conflict c-149, c-160)

The 'Status updated' glance card shows a live count for the category of the notifications whose status changed in the past 24 hours, and it matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-080; conflict c-148)
openQuestions: Blocked: the authorities' case system must send post-submission outcomes (inspection required, delayed, completed) back to the notification record. Who: the owners of that integration must provide the outcome feed; until they do, no notification reaches these statuses and none of this can be built or observed.
Blocked as well, for the 'Completed' status and its style: a real source of completion must exist (Sam, 16 November). Who: the owners of the authorities' outcome feed.

Blocked as well, for the status-updated count: the front door's dashboard requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October). Who: Sam and the people those requirements are agreed with; the count is re-distilled with the summary information.
Whether plants' card follows the 'Completed' status is decided when this unblocks.
rows.notes: Rewrite of existing row inc-142, still blocked: the combiner keeps its id, its animals-dashboard theme, its repos and its dependencies on the card row, the tabs row and the glance-cards row. Keeps every requirement the authorities' outcome feed blocks apart, so the list rows build now. Once unblocked, the animals backend's record takes the outcomes, statuses only ever being added, and the animals frontend's card, tabs and status filter pick them up. The 'Delayed' card's message is the recorded reason, because the design's own message there is placeholder copy. Re-distil: the card-actions criterion now says a notification that needs something from the trader rather than naming the status the 16 November ruling withdrew (c-418), and the 16 November ruling's confirmation that no source of completion exists is added as its own block.

rows.title: Plants' list tabs, eight a page, search, sort and filters, once the plants backend can query them
rows.detail: Plants' list takes the same tabs, paging, search, sort and additional filters as the live animals list, but each needs the plants backend, outside this programme, to query plants notifications by status, page size, keyword and arrival date. They wait together, and plants' list keeps today's search, sort and paging meanwhile.
acceptanceCriteria: Plants' list shows 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs with the same count, subheadings and status grouping as the live animals list. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p1-011, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-025, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-029, repo-plantsfrontend-p1-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-072, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-302)
